programmes.d: James is in Burgundy, a region famous for its wines and mustard fields.
James’ first stop takes him back to the place that inspired his passion for food.
James continues on to the Canal du Midi.
James visits Languedoc - famous for its wine and the hearty meaty dish, cassoulet.
James is in picturesque Charente in the heart of the Cognac region.
James visits a region known for its traditional hearty cuisine, the Dordogne!
James ventures to Lyon, known as the ‘Gastronomic Capital of France’.
James is on the stunning shore of Annecy’s crystal-clear lake.
James is heading eastwards to the region of Jura.
James visits Bresse, home of one of France’s prized ingredients, the Bresse chicken.
